adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, the feed item body is taken as `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and passed directly to `TopicEmbed.import`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates the post with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true`, and Post#cook returns `raw` unchanged when `cook_method` is `:raw_html`. The embed view renders it via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. Therefore any HTML (including `<script>`, iframes, or event-handler attributes) present in the feed content will be stored and rendered without sanitization, and `CGI.unescapeHTML` can convert entity-encoded markup back into active tags.
